notes.title: New Video: Making of Cosmic Flow: A Relaxing VR Experience
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=41-PyQFyxLo;full][/previewyoutube]

Hi hi,
The behind the scenes video is finally here! I hope you enjoy it, in it I talk about the theory and the development process behind Cosmic Flow. It was quite a journey to make my first app and the response has been incredibly inspiring. I am deeply grateful for the support and the feedback. Thank you, thank you! 
Please let me know if you have any questions and let's keep making wonderful experiences!

notes.title: Cosmic Flow: A Relaxing VR Experience has been released!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=hsNElxa01qY;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope this experience will help people relax in these times of trouble.

I'm a visual artist by trade using VR as a creative medium to make meaningful experiences that have a positive impact. This experience uses elements of the visual language to convey a smooth rhythm, a relaxed flow - a sort of visual massage. I hope this experience helps to build a habit of relaxation for more passionate, playful, creative living.
